decision: Selected the centroid of Denton County parcel 206703 (A1130A T.S. Rayburn, Tract 2B, 24.8413 legal acres, owner AIL Investment LP c/o Hillwood) as the campus locator for Colovore Alliance. It locates the landowner's tract named by the City of Fort Worth's data-centre building-permit application, not the building footprint or a surveyed lot.
